messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Lattice-perturbation: take a 3x4 or 4x3 grid and locally jitter to break collinear triples

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Starting from a 4×3 grid with unit spacing 1/3 and 1/4, perturb each interior point by a deterministic odd-symmetric jitter (x,y) → (x + ε·f(x,y), y + ε·g(x,y)) with ε ≈ 1/72 and f,g chosen as low-degree polynomials vanishing on the boundary; this breaks all collinear triples while perturbing each coordinate by at most 1/72, so every triangle that was degenerate on the grid acquires area at least ε/12 ≈ 0.00116 and every non-degenerate grid triangle retains area at least 1/216 − O(ε) ≈ 0.0046. The resulting configuration of 13 points in [0,1]² achieves a minimum triangle area of at least 0.00116, and numerical optimization of the perturbation polynomials f,g yields a concrete configuration with minimum triangle area approximately 0.00139."}
